proof_body:
by
  intro R _ I J K
  ext x
  simp only [Submodule.mem_colon, smul_eq_mul, SetLike.mem_coe]
  constructor
  · intro h y hy
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hy ?_ ?_
    · intro a ha b hb
      have := h b hb a ha
      convert this using 1
      ring
    · intro a b ha hb
      rw [mul_add]
      exact I.add_mem ha hb
  · intro h y hy z hz
    have := h (z * y) (Ideal.mul_mem_mul hz hy)
    convert this using 1
    ring
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I J K : Ideal R), (I.colon (J : Set R)).colon (K : Set R) = I.colon ((J * K : Ideal R) : Set R)
